pages.parent: 點太陽後水窪慢慢縮小，代表時間加快的蒸發；不是太陽一按就立刻蒸發。液態水變成看不見的水蒸氣，任何溫度都可能發生，不需煮沸。畫面沒有白霧或可見的水蒸氣粒子；水滴主角只代表敘事角色。
拖曳或點雲會放大顯示裡面的小水滴。水蒸氣在涼空氣裡凝結成小水滴；小水滴聚在一起形成可見的雲，雲也可能含冰晶。放大水滴只供觀察，不代表真實大小；有雲不一定下雨。
把兩滴雲中小水滴拖碰，或點其中一滴，會示意水滴碰合長大後落下。真實雲中會發生很多次碰合，也有其他降雨機制；動畫加速並簡化這段過程。葉子可以反覆點，回應雨落到森林。
雪花由雲中冰晶長大，並非雨滴直接結冰。此場景的雪經過冷空氣落地。英文可點小太陽，看手套上的雪受到溫暖而融化；這是地面融雪，不是雲中雨雪冰雹的單一溫度切換器。
點或向上拖小冰粒，先讓強上升氣流托住，再碰上過冷水滴；水滴接觸冰粒後凍結，使冰粒長大。再點一次讓長大的冰粒落成冰雹。這是同一雷雨雲中的簡化過程，沒有宣稱每顆冰雹都反覆上下繞圈。
點河流、土壤或水池，水可以沿地表流動、滲入土壤，或暫時儲存在池中。路線可任選、重玩，沒有規定每滴水都走固定的一圈。卡通主角不是水分子的外觀或尺度。

voices.zh-book-pond-intro: 我是小水滴。陽光暖暖的，摸摸太陽，陪我在池邊待一會兒。
voices.en-book-pond-intro: I am Little Drop. It is a sunny day. Touch the sun and wait with me.
voices.zh-book-pond-sun: 過了一會兒，水窪變小了！一些水變成看不見的水蒸氣，進入空氣。
voices.en-book-pond-sun: After a while, the puddle is smaller! Some water goes into the air. We cannot see it.
voices.zh-book-pond-puddle: 咦，水面一圈一圈地搖。再碰一下，跟小水滴打個招呼吧！
voices.en-book-pond-puddle: Hello, shiny puddle! Tap the water. Look at the ripples!
voices.zh-book-clouds-intro: 我們來到涼涼的天空。摸摸這朵雲，看看裡面藏著什麼。
voices.en-book-clouds-intro: The air is cool up here. Touch the cloud. What is inside?
voices.zh-book-clouds-touch: 好多小水滴！水蒸氣遇到涼空氣，變成小水滴，聚在一起成了雲。
voices.en-book-clouds-touch: In cool air, water vapor becomes tiny drops. The tiny drops make a cloud!
voices.zh-book-rain-intro: 兩滴小水滴，想靠在一起。把它們拖過來碰一碰，也可以點一下。
voices.en-book-rain-intro: Two little drops want to meet. Drag them together, or tap a drop.
voices.zh-book-rain-merge: 水滴越長越大，從雲裡落下來。滴答滴答，下雨了！
voices.en-book-rain-merge: The drops join and grow. Now they are big enough to fall. Here comes the rain!
voices.zh-book-rain-leaf: 雨點落在葉子上，葉子搖一搖。森林也喝到水了。
voices.en-book-rain-leaf: Rain lands on the leaves. Wiggle, wiggle! The forest gets a drink.
voices.zh-book-snow-intro: 冷冷的雲裡，雪花長大了。摸摸它，看它飄呀飄。
voices.en-book-snow-intro: Look! Snow grows in a cold cloud. Touch a snowflake. Watch it float down.
voices.zh-book-snow-touch: 輕輕轉，慢慢飄。白白的雪，落到地上囉！
voices.en-book-snow-touch: The snowflakes turn and float. Down to the snowy ground!
voices.zh-book-snow-catch: 手套接住一片雪！找找看，它有幾個尖尖的角？
voices.en-book-snow-catch: A snowflake on my mitten! Can you count its points?
voices.zh-book-snow-warm: 陽光暖暖的。手套上的雪融化了，變成一滴水。
voices.en-book-snow-warm: The sun feels warm. The snow on the mitten melts. Now it is a drop of water!
voices.zh-book-storm-intro: 雷雨雲裡有顆小冰粒。把它往上推，或點一下，讓風托住它！
voices.en-book-storm-intro: A little ice ball is in a storm cloud. Push it up, or tap it. Let the wind hold it!
voices.zh-book-storm-lift: 呼！強強的風，把冰粒托在雲裡。再點冰粒，讓它碰到小水滴。
voices.en-book-storm-lift: Whoosh! Strong wind holds the ice ball in the cloud. Tap it again to meet the little drops.
voices.zh-book-storm-grow: 小水滴碰到冰粒，凍在上面，冰粒長大了！再點一下，看它往下落。
voices.en-book-storm-grow: Little drops freeze onto the ice ball. It gets bigger! Tap it again and watch it fall.
voices.zh-book-storm-fall: 風托不住大冰粒了。它往下落，成了冰雹，咚咚咚！
voices.en-book-storm-fall: The wind cannot hold the big ice ball now. Down it comes. That is hail!
voices.zh-book-river-intro: 回到地面囉。點點河流、土壤或水池，水會走哪條路呢？
voices.en-book-river-intro: Back on the ground! Touch the river, the soil, or the pool. Where will water go?
voices.zh-book-river-river: 沿著彎彎的河，水往低的地方流。嘩啦啦，我們走吧！
voices.en-book-river-river: Down the winding river, water flows to lower ground. Here we go!
voices.zh-book-river-soil: 水慢慢滲進土裡。有些水，會在地下待很久。
voices.en-book-river-soil: Water soaks into the soil. Some water stays underground for a long time.
voices.zh-book-river-pool: 水在池子裡休息。不用急，水有好多條路，不一定走同一圈。
voices.en-book-river-pool: Water rests in the pool. No rush! Water has many paths. It does not always go in one circle.
voices.zh-book-ending: 今天的旅行到這裡。你最想回哪一頁，再陪水玩一次？
voices.en-book-ending: Our story ends here. Where would you like to go again? Come and play with water!
